book.title: Yohannisi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Lo7o Heenththanchcha
Yesusi, «Ta inttes tumu gays; dorsata yiren pengerappe attiin hara baggara guppi gelizay kaysonne bonqqizaade.
Pengera gelizaadey izi dorsata heemmizaade.
Penge naagizaadey izas pengeza doyees. Dorsatikka iza qaala siyeettes; ba dorsata sunththara sunththara xeygi kessees.
Bayta ubbaa kessidaappe guye istta sinth aadhdhidi kaaleththees; dorsatikka iza qaala eriza gishshas iza kaalleettes.
Imaththa asa qaala erontta gishshas izappe baqateettes attiin mulekka iza kaallettenna» gides.
Yesusi hessa leemisoza isttas yootides shin istti qasse izi isttas yootidayssa aykkoka eribeettenna.
Hessa gishshas Yesusi qasseka isttas, «Ta inttes tumu gays; dorsata pengey tana.
Taappe kase yidayti wuri kaysonne bonqqizayta. Dorsati gidikko istti gizaa siyibeettenna.
Pengey tana; ta baggara gelizaadey wuri attana; gelananne kezana; heemettizasokka demmana.
Kaysoy kaysotana, wodhanaassinne dhayssanaas xalla yees. Tani gidikko inttes de7oy daana malanne inttes keehi darana mala yadis.
«Tani lo7o heenththanchcha; lo7o heenththanchchay ba shemppo ba dorsata gishshas aaththi immees.
Miishshera qaxxarettidi heemmizaadey gidikko dorsati izas gidontta gishshas kana suytey yiza wode dorsata yeggidi baas baqatees. Kana suyteykka dorsata dafi dafi meessinne laallees.
Baqatizaadey miishshan qaxxarettidaade gidida gishshassinne dorsatas mishettontta gishshassa.
«Lo7o heenththanchchay tana; tani ta dorsata erays; isttika tana ereettes.
Hessika Aaway tana erizayssa mala tani ta shemppo dorsata gishshas aaththa immana.
Hayssa ha dorsa yiren gelonttayti taas hara dorsati deettes; ta isttaka haa ehanaas taas bessees; isttika ta qaala siyananne issi mehe gidana. Heemmizayssika issaade gidana.
Ta zaarada denththanaas ta shemppo aaththa immiza gishshas ta Aaway tana dosees.

Tani ta shemppo ta dosara aaththa immadis attiin oonikka taappe woththi ekkenna; ta aaththa immanaas gidiin woykko zaara denththanaas gidiin sheney taassa; hessa he azazoza tani ta Aawappe ekkadis» gides.
Hessa he qaalaappe dendidayssan Ayhudata giddon qasseka shaaketeththi medhettides.
Daro asay, «Iza bolla daydanththi diza gishshassinne izi goosh gidida gishshas intte izi gizayssa ays siyeetii?» gida.
Baggayti qasse, «Daydanththi dizaadey hayssa mala deenna; daydanththi qooqida ayfe paththi erizee?» gida.
Ayhudati Ammanontta Ixxida
Yerusalaamen Xoossa Keeththa ooraththo ba7aale bonchcho wodey gakkides; he wodeykka balgo.
Yesusi Xoossa Keeththa gibbe giddon Solomoone simereteththasora aadhdhishin,
Ayhudati iza giddo aaththidi, «Ne ayde gakkanaas nu wozina hirgan gam7isanee? Ne Xoossi kiittidaade gidikko nuus qonccisa yoota» gida.
Yesusikka isttas, «Ta inttes yootadiskoshin intte gidikko ammanibeekketa. Ta Aawaa sunththan ta ooththiza malatati ta gishshas yooteettes.
Intte qasse ta dorsata gidontta gishshas tana ammanekketa.
Ta dorsati ta qaala siyeettes. Tanikka istta erays; isttika tana kaalleettes.
Ta isttas mernaa de7o immana; mulekka istti dhayettenna; istta ta kusheppe woththi ekkanaas dandayanaadey oonikka deenna.
Taas istta immida ta Aaway ubbaafe aadhdhees; ta Aawa kusheppe istta oonikka bonqqanaas dandayenna.
Taninne ta aaway nu issino» gides.
Ayhudati iza caddanaas qasseka shuch denththida.
Yesusikka, «Aawappe gidida daro gita malaatata ta inttena bessadis. Histtiin ha ta bessidaytappe awaari gishshas tana shuchchara caddeetii?» gides.
Ayhudatikka, «Nu nena shuchchara caddizay ne as gida uttada nena nerkka Xoos kessada cashsha qaala ne haasayda gishshassafe attiin ne lo7o ooththidayssa gishshas deenna» giidi izas zaarida.
Yesusikka isttas, «Intte wogaa giddon, ‹Ta inttena Xoossata gadis› geetetti xaafettibeennee?
Xoossa qaalay isttas yida asata, ‹Xoossi giikko Maxaafay shaarettanaas dandayonttaa gidikko›
histtiin, ‹Ta Xoossa naa› gida gishshas Aaway ba shaakki dummasidayssanne haa duge alame kiittidayssa intte, ‹Ne cayadasa› giidi tana wordora aazas mooteetii?
Ta Aaway ooththizayssa ta ooththontta aggiko tanan ammanopite.
Ta izaththo ooththizaa gidikko intte tana ammanontta aggikokka ta Aaway tanan dizayssa tanikka izan dizayssa intte erana malanne yuushshi qoppana mala izi ooththida malaataan ammanite» gides.
Qasseka istti iza oykkanaas koyida shin izi istta kusheppe kessi ekki bides.
Hessafe guye Yesusi, Yohannisi kase xammaqizaso Yordaanooseppe he pinth simmidi heen gam7ides.
Daro asay izakko yides; istti qasse, «Yohannisi issi malaatakka ooththibeenna; gido attiin hayssa addeza gishshas izi yootidayssi wurikka tumukko» gida.
Heenkka daro asay Yesusan ammanides.
